decisions.reason: Substantive security research: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 analysis of Kubernetes operator RBAC over-privilege and open-source OperTraitor tool. Real security substance.
OpenSSL and WolfSSL security patches including high-severity CVE-2026-84782 DTLS memory disclosure. Already part of canonical patch story.
Microsoft DART report on Storm-3068 Azure DevOps pipeline abuse and Kubernetes credential theft. Original event for the story.
TeamFiltration campaign targeting 5,714 Microsoft 365 accounts via forgotten service accounts; primary research with victim counts and AWS infrastructure details.
CVE-2026-72018 Linux kernel out-of-bounds write enabling local root escalation; technical vulnerability with CVSS 7.8 and PoC context.
Update to the Storm-3068 intrusion detailing identity abuse, malicious pipeline creation, and kube agent deployment. Belongs to existing story.
Unsloth Studio critical ACE via malicious Hugging Face model repositories; fixed in v2026.6.9. Substantive vulnerability with demonstrated exploitation path.
RATHat Android banking trojan combining Gemini AI and ADB abuse; technical malware analysis with infection chain and architecture details.
Update on Unsloth Studio ACE: Pillar Security findings, config.json auto_map exploitation, and proof-of-concept. Part of existing Unsloth story.
SectopRAT campaign hiding encrypted payload inside a legitimate digital audio workstation folder; incident response details with infection chain and DLL abuse.
SectopRAT malware analysis describing how attackers weaponize trusted software components to conceal RAT and steal credentials/crypto; same story as canonical.
Update on RATHat demonstrating generative AI operationalized in mobile malware; Gemini navigation and AI-driven victim targeting. Same RATHat story.
ShinyHunters alleged leader arrest (24-year-old from Amsterdam); FBI and Dutch police coordination, $70M extortion network. Merged into canonical 23-event ShinyHunters story.
OpenSSL 14-vulnerability patch release including CVE-2026-84782 high-severity DTLS out-of-bounds read; part of canonical OpenSSL story.
OpenAI Codex Security Cloud product announcement; vendor marketing with no security event, vulnerability, breach, or advisory substance. Drop.
OpenSSL high-severity DTLS flaw (CVE-2026-84782) allowing remote heap memory read; technical advisory detail. Part of canonical OpenSSL story.
OpenAI Codex Security Cloud marketing announcement; continuous scanning platform launch with no concrete vulnerability, attack, or breach. Drop.
ShinyHunters arrest announcement by FBI and Dutch police; suspect identified, international coordination, significant law-enforcement development. Part of canonical ShinyHunters story.
Social Mastodon post (Italian) on AI guardrails; commentary without primary security event, vulnerability, or breach substance. Not primary reporting.
Social Mastodon post (French) referencing forgotten accounts; commentary linking to an article, not primary reporting of a security event. Not a story mint.
